title: Remove scheduler-sensitive Engram recovery test deadline
outcome: During the 2026-08-28 Engram A0/MCP gate, unbounded default-parallel cargo test tests::engram_host_adapter produced 85/86: disable_preserves_uncheckpointed_authority_and_reenable_repairs_the_same_session recorded recovery session_bind + turn_evaluate but omitted turn_begin. The exact test passed in isolation (1/1) and the full suite passed with --test-threads=1 (86/86), proving environment/resource contention against the production wall-clock dispatch budget rather than an adapter semantic failure. Next action: make this recovery assertion deterministic under scheduler contention (or explicitly execute the suite through the bounded scripts/test-rust.sh contract) without weakening the expected operation sequence.
